text:
AN314
Animals and People
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
This
course
explores anthropological and related approaches to human relationships with non-human animals. It will consider the ways in which animals may be food, commodities, companions, kin, pests, wildlife, workers, spirits, and scientific objects in a variety of social, cultural and political settings.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
AN100
, AN110 or AN120, or by permission of instructor
Exclusions
AN307U.
